## Data import

```{r}

# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
#library(RColorBrewer) # Commented out unused libraries

# Load BDNF data from a text file and display the first few rows
bdnf <- as_tibble(read.table('/home/kobi/Work/TBM-R-Analysis/tables/Ausgangstabellen/bdnf.txt', 
                   sep = "\t", 
                   header = TRUE, 
                   row.names = NULL,
```

## Subset of the essential variables



```{r}
# Subsetting BDNF data to include only specific columns
bdnf_subset <- subset(bdnf, select = c(ID, Standort, Zeitpunkt, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel))

# Subsetting BDNF CpG columns and calculating mean and median values for each row
bdnf_methylation <- subset(bdnf, select = c("m148", "m066", "m111", "m058"))
bdnf_methylation_mean <- apply(bdnf_methylation, 1, mean, na.rm=TRUE)
bdnf_methylation_median <- apply(bdnf_methylation, 1, median, na.rm=TRUE)

# Combining the subset data with the calculated mean and median values
bdnf_mean <- cbind(bdnf_subset, bdnf_methylation_mean)
colnames(bdnf_mean)[8] <- "Mean"
bdnf_median <- cbind(bdnf_subset, bdnf_methylation_median)
colnames(bdnf_median)[8] <- "Median"

# Removing rows with specific IDs due to data issues
bdnf_mean <- bdnf_mean[!(bdnf_mean$ID %in% c(192, 193)), ]
bdnf_mean[bdnf_mean$ID >= 190 & bdnf_mean$ID <= 196, ] # Display rows to verify deletion

bdnf_median <- bdnf_median[!(bdnf_median$ID %in% c(192, 193)), ]
bdnf_median[bdnf_median$ID >= 190 & bdnf_median$ID <= 196, ] # Display rows to verify deletion

bdnf_mean[1:5,]
bdnf_median[1:5,]

# Subsetting Tau data and renaming columns
tau_subset <- subset(tau, select = c(ID, standort_aus_andere_quelle, Zeit, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel))
colnames(tau_subset)[c(2:3)] <- c("Standort", "Zeitpunkt")

# Subsetting Tau CpG columns and calculating mean and median values for each row
tau_methylation <- subset(tau, select = c("m331", "m337", "m310", "m315", "m323"))
tau_methylation_mean <- apply(tau_methylation, 1, mean, na.rm = TRUE)
tau_methylation_median <- apply(tau_methylation, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Combining the subset data with the calculated mean and median values
tau_mean <- cbind(tau_subset, tau_methylation_mean)
colnames(tau_mean)[8] <- "Mean"
tau_median <- cbind(tau_subset, tau_methylation_median)
colnames(tau_median)[8] <- "Median"

# Removing rows with specific IDs due to data issues
tau_mean <- tau_mean[!(tau_mean$ID %in% c(192, 193)), ]
tau_mean[tau_mean$ID >= 190 & tau_mean$ID <= 196, ]

tau_median <- tau_median[!(tau_median$ID %in% c(192, 193)), ]
tau_median[tau_median$ID >= 190 & tau_median$ID <= 196, ]

tau_mean[1:5,]
tau_median[1:5,]

# Subsetting PSD95 data and renaming columns
psd95_subset <- subset(psd95, select = c(ID, standort_aus_andere_quelle, Zeitpunkt, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel))
colnames(psd95_subset)[2] <- "Standort"

# Subsetting PSD95 CpG columns and calculating mean and median values for each row
psd95_methylation <- subset(psd95, select = c("p95", "p60", "p23"))

psd95_methylation_median <- apply(psd95_methylation, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)

# Combining the subset data with the calculated mean and median values

colnames(psd95_mean)[8] <- "Mean"
psd95_median <- cbind(psd95_subset, psd95_methylation_median)
colnames(psd95_median)[8] <- "Median"

# Removing rows with specific IDs due to data issues

psd95_mean[psd95_mean$ID >= 190 & psd95_mean$ID <= 196, ]

psd95_median <- psd95_median[!(psd95_median$ID %in% c(192, 193)), ]

psd95_mean[1:5,]
```

## Pivot time points to columns

```{r}
# Define the two split_zeitpunkt functions for mean and median
split_zeitpunkt_mean <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ID, Standort, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel), # no doublets!
                names_from = Zeitpunkt, # Pivot Zeitpunkt from long to wide format
                values_from = Mean)
}

split_zeitpunkt_median <- function(data) {
  data %>%
    pivot_wider(id_cols = c(ID, Standort, Gruppe, Sex, Age_start, CogTel), # no doublets!
                names_from = Zeitpunkt, # Pivot Zeitpunkt from long to wide format
                values_from = Median)
}

# Run the function and check the first few rows

# Apply to BDNF mean data
bdnf_mean_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_mean(bdnf_mean)
head(bdnf_mean_wide)
nrow(bdnf_mean_wide) # Expecting 144 rows

# Apply to BDNF median data
bdnf_median_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_median(bdnf_median)
head(bdnf_median_wide)
nrow(bdnf_median_wide) # Expecting 144 rows

# Apply to Tau mean data
tau_mean_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_mean(tau_mean)
head(tau_mean_wide)
nrow(tau_mean_wide) # Expecting 145 rows

# Apply to Tau median data
tau_median_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_median(tau_median)
head(tau_median_wide)
nrow(tau_median_wide) # Expecting 145 rows

# Apply to PSD95 mean data
psd95_mean_wide <- split_zeitpunkt_mean(psd95_mean)
head(psd95_mean_wide)
nrow(psd95_mean_wide) # Expecting 145 rows

# Apply to PSD95 median data

nrow(psd95_median_wide) # Expecting 145 rows
```

## Plots

### Methylation levels across time points

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactions-no-group-by-filtered-cpg
#| fig-cap: "Methylation levels (mean ± SE) across time points collapsed across groups for BDNF, Tau, and PSD95."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

make_nogroup_plot <- function(df_wide, title,
                              ylab = "Mean methylation (mean across CpGs)") {

  df_long <- df_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(T0, T1, T2),
                 names_to = "Zeitpunkt",
                 values_to = "Mean") %>%
    mutate(Zeitpunkt = factor(Zeitpunkt, levels = c("T0","T1","T2")))

  sum0 <- df_long %>%
    group_by(Zeitpunkt) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(Mean)),
      mean = mean(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      se   = sd(Mean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot(sum0, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = mean, group = 1)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Time Point", y = ylab,
         caption = "Points show mean across participants; error bars are ±SE.")
}

p_bdnf0  <- make_nogroup_plot(bdnf_mean_wide,  title = "BDNF")
p_tau0   <- make_nogroup_plot(tau_mean_wide,   title = "Tau")
p_psd950 <- make_nogroup_plot(psd95_mean_wide, title = "PSD95")

(p_bdnf0 / p_tau0 / p_psd950)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactions-no-group-by-filtered-cpg-with-significance
#| fig-cap: "Methylation levels (mean ± SE) across time points collapsed across groups for BDNF, Tau, and PSD95. Brackets show pairwise timepoint contrasts (mixed model: Mean ~ Zeitpunkt + (1|ID))."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 10

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)
library(ggsignif)

p_to_star <- function(p){
  ifelse(is.na(p), "NA",
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05,  "*", "ns"))))
}

make_nogroup_plot <- function(df_wide, title,
                              ylab = "Mean methylation (mean across CpGs)") {

  df_long <- df_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(T0, T1, T2),
                 names_to = "Zeitpunkt",
                 values_to = "Mean") %>%
    mutate(
      Zeitpunkt = factor(Zeitpunkt, levels = c("T0","T1","T2")),
      ID = factor(ID)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Mean))

  # summary stats (SE)
  sum0 <- df_long %>%
    group_by(Zeitpunkt) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(Mean),
      se   = sd(Mean) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # mixed model for timepoint differences (within-subject)
  fit <- lmer(Mean ~ Zeitpunkt + (1 | ID), data = df_long, REML = TRUE)

  # pairwise contrasts between timepoints
  pw <- as.data.frame(pairs(emmeans(fit, ~ Zeitpunkt))) %>%
    transmute(
      contrast,
      p.value,
      label = p_to_star(p.value)
    ) %>%
    separate(contrast, into = c("x1", "x2"), sep = " - ")

  # bracket y-positions (stacked)
  y_top  <- max(sum0$mean + sum0$se, na.rm = TRUE)
  y_step <- 0.08 * diff(range(sum0$mean, na.rm = TRUE))
  if (!is.finite(y_step) || y_step == 0) y_step <- 0.01

  pw <- pw %>%
    mutate(y_position = y_top + y_step * row_number())

  ggplot(sum0, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = mean, group = 1)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
    ggsignif::geom_signif(
      data = pw,
      aes(xmin = x1, xmax = x2, annotations = label, y_position = y_position),
      manual = TRUE,
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      textsize = 4,
      tip_length = 0.01
    ) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Time Point",
      y = ylab,
      caption = "Error bars are ±SE. Brackets: pairwise timepoint contrasts from mixed model."
    )
}

p_bdnf0  <- make_nogroup_plot(bdnf_mean_wide,  title = "BDNF")
p_tau0   <- make_nogroup_plot(tau_mean_wide,   title = "Tau")
p_psd950 <- make_nogroup_plot(psd95_mean_wide, title = "PSD95")

(p_bdnf0 / p_tau0 / p_psd950)

```


### Methylation levels across time points by group

```{r}
#| label: fig-interactions-by-group-filtered-cpg
#| fig-cap: "Methylation levels (mean ± SE) across time points by group for BDNF, Tau, and PSD95."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 12
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

make_interaction_plot <- function(df_wide, title, ylab = "Mean methylation (mean across CpGs)") {

  df_long <- df_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(T0, T1, T2),
                 names_to = "Zeitpunkt",
                 values_to = "Mean") %>%
    mutate(
      Zeitpunkt = factor(Zeitpunkt, levels = c("T0", "T1", "T2")),
      Gruppe = factor(Gruppe)
    )

  summary_stats <- df_long %>%
    group_by(Zeitpunkt, Gruppe) %>%
    summarise(
      n = sum(!is.na(Mean)),
      mean = mean(Mean, na.rm = TRUE),
      se = sd(Mean, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = mean, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - se, ymax = mean + se), width = 0.2) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Time Point", y = ylab, caption = "Points show mean across participants; error bars are ±SE.")
}

# BDNF
p_bdnf <-
make_interaction_plot(
  bdnf_mean_wide,
  title = "Interaction Plot of BDNF Methylation Levels by Group and Time"
)

# TAU
p_tau <-
make_interaction_plot(
  tau_mean_wide,
  title = "Interaction Plot of Tau Methylation Levels by Group and Time"
)

# PSD95
p_psd95 <-
make_interaction_plot(
  psd95_mean_wide,
  title = "Interaction Plot of PSD95 Methylation Levels by Group and Time"
)


(p_bdnf / p_tau / p_psd95) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```


```{r}
#| label: fig-interactions-by-group-filtered-cpg-with-significance
#| fig-cap: "Methylation levels (mean ± 95% CI) across time points by group for BDNF, Tau, and PSD95. Stars indicate Piano vs Control contrasts within each time point (mixed model: Mean ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + (1|ID))."
#| fig-width: 8
#| fig-height: 12

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(lme4)
library(emmeans)

p_to_star <- function(p){
  ifelse(is.na(p), "NA",
  ifelse(p < 0.001, "***",
  ifelse(p < 0.01,  "**",
  ifelse(p < 0.05,  "*", "ns"))))
}

plot_gene_piano_vs_control <- function(df_wide, gene_title,
                                       ylab = "Mean methylation (across CpGs)") {

  # Ensure factor order so the contrast is Piano - Control
  df_long <- df_wide %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(T0, T1, T2),
                 names_to = "Zeitpunkt",
                 values_to = "Mean") %>%
    mutate(
      Zeitpunkt = factor(Zeitpunkt, levels = c("T0", "T1", "T2")),
      Gruppe = factor(Gruppe, levels = c("Controll", "Piano")),
      ID = factor(ID)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(Mean))

  # Mixed model (participant-level)
  fit <- lmer(Mean ~ Gruppe * Zeitpunkt + (1 | ID), data = df_long, REML = TRUE)

  # Piano vs Control at each timepoint
  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ Gruppe | Zeitpunkt)
  contr <- as.data.frame(contrast(emm, method = list("Piano - Control" = c(-1, 1))))

  pvals <- contr %>%
    transmute(
      Zeitpunkt,
      p.value,
      label = p_to_star(p.value)
    )

  # Plot stats (95% CI)
  summary_stats <- df_long %>%
    group_by(Zeitpunkt, Gruppe) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n(),
      mean = mean(Mean),
      sd = sd(Mean),
      se = sd / sqrt(n),
      ci = qt(0.975, df = n - 1) * se,
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # Annotation y-positions (above the top CI at each timepoint)
  y_pad <- 0.05 * diff(range(summary_stats$mean, na.rm = TRUE))
  ann <- summary_stats %>%
    group_by(Zeitpunkt) %>%
    summarise(y = max(mean + ci, na.rm = TRUE) + y_pad, .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(pvals, by = "Zeitpunkt")

  ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = mean, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(data = ann, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = y, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0, size = 4) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = gene_title,
      x = "Time Point",
      y = ylab,
      caption = "Error bars are 95% CI. Stars: Piano vs Control within timepoint from mixed model."
    )
}

p_bdnf  <- plot_gene_piano_vs_control(bdnf_mean_wide,  "BDNF")
p_tau   <- plot_gene_piano_vs_control(tau_mean_wide,   "Tau")
p_psd95 <- plot_gene_piano_vs_control(psd95_mean_wide, "PSD95")

(p_bdnf / p_tau / p_psd95) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```

```{r}
    )

  # Annotation y-positions (above the top CI at each timepoint)
  y_pad <- 0.05 * diff(range(summary_stats$mean, na.rm = TRUE))
  ann <- summary_stats %>%
    group_by(Zeitpunkt) %>%
    summarise(y = max(mean + ci, na.rm = TRUE) + y_pad, .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(pvals, by = "Zeitpunkt")

  ggplot(summary_stats, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = mean, group = Gruppe, colour = Gruppe)) +
    geom_line() +
    geom_point() +
    geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci), width = 0.2) +
    geom_text(data = ann, aes(x = Zeitpunkt, y = y, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE, vjust = 0, size = 4) +
    theme_classic() +
    labs(
      title = gene_title,
      x = "Time Point",
      y = ylab,
      caption = "Error bars are 95% CI. Stars: Piano vs Control within timepoint from mixed model."
    )
}

p_bdnf  <- plot_gene_piano_vs_control(bdnf_mean_wide,  "BDNF")
p_tau   <- plot_gene_piano_vs_control(tau_mean_wide,   "Tau")
p_psd95 <- plot_gene_piano_vs_control(psd95_mean_wide, "PSD95")

(p_bdnf / p_tau / p_psd95) + plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

```
